user.description: Select the heater. After submitting, its LED blinks fast: press the 2H button on the thermostat within 30 seconds to confirm pairing. Close the ACOVA Control app on your phone.

confirm.description: Add the ACOVA heater "{name}"? After submitting, its LED blinks fast: press the 2H button on the thermostat within 30 seconds.

error.pairing_failed: Pairing refused or timed out. Press the 2H button when the LED blinks fast, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Heater not found or out of Bluetooth range.
